name: Horizon Agent Containment
summary: Deterministic containment around explicitly modeled agent state, provenance, authority, capabilities, and security invariants.
capabilities: Capabilities derived from accumulated state and graph relationships
Hypothetical transitions with atomic commit or discard
Fail-closed decisions for invalid modeled inputs
scope: The engine controls its modeled state. A trusted integration must represent real effects accurately and honor decisions. It is not an OS sandbox, universal tool interceptor, IAM replacement, or guarantee of arbitrary-agent containment.

evidence.browser_behavior: Replays recorded Python engine results. No tool execution occurs in the browser.
